raw.product_description: Narma is a three-layered system. Layer 1 (Observe) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, including application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2 (Intelligence Layer) is a "Brain" that detects employee intent, the business value of tasks, and "drift" in workflows. Layer 3 (Execution Layer) is an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for high-ROI opportunities, with built-in approval gates. It leverages existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to identify areas for AI assistance.
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's core innovation is a three-layered "Enterprise Agentic Brain" that observes work patterns, understands intent and business value, and automates AI agent deployment. It leverages existing foundation models, focusing on the "Work Graph" to identify valuable AI intervention points, which contrasts with approaches centered on building new LLMs.

raw.thesis: Narma is creating an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to address the significant challenges of deploying AI automation at scale. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an observation layer that captures work patterns, an intelligence layer that detects employee intent and business value, and an execution layer that automatically generates and deploys AI agents. This system focuses on understanding the "Work Graph" to identify high-ROI opportunities for AI intervention, rather than developing new foundation models. The venture aims to provide a single, continuous system for observing work, deciding AI actions, and continuously building agents to ensure ongoing "AI lift." This helps AI-first enterprises overcome issues like lack of telemetry for AI savings, unreliable ROI measurement, and process drift. Narma positions itself as a complement to existing AI foundation models, enhancing their practical application within enterprise workflows. The founder's goal appears to be a growth startup, given the focus on scaling AI automation within enterprises. The venture is currently at the idea stage, as evidenced by the description of the architecture and vision without mention of a built product or users. There is no evidence of thesis evolution, as no documents were provided.
